title: Tetranuclear {CoII2CoIII2}, Octanuclear {CoII4CoIII4}, and Hexanuclear {CoIII3DyIII3} Pivalate Clusters: Synthesis, Magnetic Characterization, and Theoretical Modeling

synthesis.procedure: Compound 4 was obtained from a reaction described as similar to the ultrasonic MeCN reaction of the dinuclear cobalt(II) pivalate precursor [Co2(H2O)(O2CCMe3)4(HO2CCMe3)4] with triethanolamine (teaH3) and NaN3, but using dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate. The recovered experimental text begins after filtration of a dark-brown solution and slow evaporation at room temperature, which first gives green crystals of tetranuclear 3 after 3 days. The filtrate kept for 1 month in a fridge at 5 °C deposits purple crystals of 4. The numerical reagent charges for this Dy-containing preparation are missing from the recoverable main-text paragraph. Results state an approximately 39% yield of 4. Aerobic commercial-grade solvents were used.
synthesis.time: 1 month at 5 °C after the initial crystallization of 3
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ultrasonic bath, then slow evaporation and refrigerated filtrate
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Purple crystals of 4 were filtered, washed with cold MeCN, water, and ethanol, and air-dried.
synthesis.yield: 0.04 g (reported as about 39% in the discussion)

properties.summary: Powder χT and magnetization of diamagnetic-CoIII/DyIII cluster 4 were measured and modeled with crystal-field, weak ferromagnetic Dy–Dy exchange (Jex = 0.8 cm−1), and antiferromagnetic intercluster coupling (zJ′ = −0.075 cm−1). Dy2 and Dy3 show negative axial anisotropy consistent with SMM behavior; strong rhombicity suppresses SMM behavior of Dy1.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; calculated uncoupled value 42.5 cm^3 K mol^-1 for three DyIII (gJ = 4/3, J = 15/2)

measurements.name: Jex
measurements.conditions: best fit with G = 1; ferromagnetic Dy–Dy exchange

measurements.name: λ
measurements.conditions: intercluster mean-field parameter; corresponding zJ′ = −0.075 cm^-1

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 1.9 K, 0–5 T; inset of Figure 9 fitted with G = 1, Jex = 0.8 cm^-1, zJ′ = −0.075 cm^-1

measurements.name: χZZT
measurements.conditions: Dy1 local frame, 1.9 K, G = 1, ZO = 0.5; transverse components near zero
